sentences.text: The in-force UCB directions say a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges in the covered floating-rate cases, including existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025 for purposes other than business and, for loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026, floating rate loans for purposes other than business and certain Tier 3 business-purpose loans up to ₹50 lakh. (E11, E12, E14)
The cited in-force directions do not state any monetary penalty amount for levying a prohibited foreclosure or pre-payment charge. (E11, E12, E14, E18)

I searched the cited RBI UCB directions and the repeal history for a penalty amount, but the evidence only shows the prohibition and the KFS reference, not a monetary penalty. (E1, E2, E11, E12, E14, E18)
